# Source: Ring with a Scarab Bezel

This GameCore theme is derived from a **specific, real, public-domain work**—not a generated palette.

## Work

- **Title:** Ring with a Scarab Bezel
- **Artist / culture:** Egyptian
- **Date:** Second Intermediate Period, Dynasty 15 (about 1650–1550 BCE)
- **Style:** middle kingdom
- **Classification:** ring (jewelry)
- **Department:** Arts of Africa
- **AIC artwork ID:** 594
- **Artwork page:** https://www.artic.edu/artworks/594
- **Public-domain image:** https://www.artic.edu/iiif/2/d9067d6e-e133-705c-cf53-528c035a5201/full/400,/0/default.jpg
- **Research category:** Egyptian Textile

## Extracted source palette

`#B8B8B8, #989898, #484838, #D8A868, #B88848, #686858, #787878, #E8C878`

The image was downsampled deterministically and quantized to a four-bit-per-channel histogram.
Colors were ranked by pixel population and de-duplicated by RGB distance. No random values are used.

## Semantic adaptation

- `background`: `#25251D`
- `surface`: `#3E3E37`
- `on_surface`: `#F8F8F6`
- `primary`: `#B88848`
- `on_primary`: `#0C0C0E`
- `secondary`: `#E8C878`
- `surface_variant`: `#3E3E37`
- `on_surface_variant`: `#F8F8F6`
- `outline`: `#60605A`
- `error`: `#B88848`
- `on_error`: `#0C0C0E`

- Font: `rounded` (chosen from source style/classification)
- Corner radius: `12dp` (chosen from source object/design classification)
- Body contrast: background `14.51:1`, surface `10.13:1`
- Variant contrast: `10.13:1`
- Control contrast: `6.19:1`

Backgrounds retain a source hue but are toned toward neutral only when needed to ensure body text is
at least 7.0:1. The primary action remains an extracted source color and its ink is chosen
for at least 4.5:1.
